name: Lift.Pairing.ScaledCupBounds.of_isSafe
summary: Fix a topology making j an open embedding. With B(y) = p^{e₃}⟨wittFst y, ·⟩ and the Artin–Schreier–Witt description of the small part S_m of W(C^♭)⊗ℤ/p^m(1), the safety conditions give for every g ∈ Γ' an element κ(g) ∈ ℤ/p^m(1) such that the cup product (g, h) ↦ p^e⟨α(c)(g), gα'(c')(h)⟩ equals r times the coboundary of κ (their difference lies in ℤ/p^m(1) ∩ S_m = 0). So the restriction of the cup-product class to the open subgroup Γ' vanishes; as [Γ : Γ'] is prime to p and the class is p^m-torsion, the class vanishes.

steps.claim: Fix a topology on Γ for which j is an open embedding (hj), and let B(y) = p^{e₃}·wittPairing(P)(wittFst(S, y), ·), a W(C^♭)-linear map W(C^♭)⊗Y' → W(C^♭)⊗ℤ/p^m(1).
steps.lean: intro _ hj; let B y := p ^ e₃ • P.wittPairing (S.wittFst y)

steps.claim: For every side T and crystalline cocycle c of T: c(g) ∈ p^m·T for all g near 1 (T is potentially crystalline; eventually_eq_pow_smul).
steps.lean: have V {T : PairingSide O} {c} h := eventually_eq_pow_smul T.inClass.isPotCrys (c := c) h P.m

steps.claim: Collect: by the description of the small part S_m = W(𝔪^♭)(1⊗1) of M = W(C^♭)⊗ℤ/p^m(1) (TateTwist.smallPart_spec, for the representation of S', trivial modulo p^m near 1 by step 2, and the map B(x)): every d ∈ M is killed by p^m and is φe − e for some e, and if φd − d ∈ S_m then d − (1⊗k) ∈ S_m for some k ∈ ℤ/p^m(1) (z); 1⊗k ∈ S_m implies k = 0 (h₀); B(x)(hv − v) ∈ S_m for h near 1 (C). Also p^e = p^{e₁+e₂+e₃}·r (he), the elements near 1 lie in Γ' (u), and the cocycle identities of α(c) and α'(c') (Z, X).
steps.lean:
obtain ⟨⟨z, h₀, C⟩, ⟨r, o⟩, u, _, Z, X, _⟩ := TateTwist.smallPart_spec (V <|
    coboundary_mem ·) (B x), pow_dvd_pow p he, nearOne_le, isLocalGalois_localFieldOf hj,
    apply_mul (S.α c).2, apply_mul (S'.α c').2, @smul_comm.{0,0,0} (FrobGroup Γ)

steps.claim: Write B(w)(wittFst(S', φx' − x')) = φy − y for some y (hd).
steps.lean: choose y hd using (z (B w (S'.wittFst (φ • x' - x')))).2.1

steps.claim: For g near 1: α'(c')(g) ∈ p^m·Y', α(c)(g) ∈ p^m·Y, B(x)(g·wittFst(S', x') − wittFst(S', x')) ∈ S_m, and gy − y ∈ S_m (the same description for the Tate twist ℤ/p^m(1) itself, whose cocycles are small near 1).
steps.lean:
have N := (V (S'.α c').2).and ((V (S.α c).2).and
    ((C (S'.wittFst x')).and ((TateTwist.smallPart_spec (Quot.ind fun c ↦
    (eventually_eq_pow_smul (isAdmissible_of_cyclotomicGp_zpow 1 (ρ := charRep ..) (by simp; tauto))
    (coboundary_mem c) _).mono fun _ ⟨w, h⟩ ↦ ⟨w, congr($h)⟩) .id).2.2 y)))

steps.claim: Near 1 in G_p means near 1 in Γ, j being an open embedding.

For g ∈ Γ' let n = (0, g) and D_g = B(nx)(n·wittFst(S', x')) − n(B(x)(wittFst(S', x')) − y) − B(x)(wittFst(S', nx' − x')) − y; choose κ(g) ∈ ℤ/p^m(1) with D_g − 1⊗κ(g) ∈ S_m (hκ), which exists by step 3 because:
steps.lean:
choose κ hκ using fun g : k.Γ' ↦ let n := inr g.1
    (z (B (n • x) (n • S'.wittFst x') - n • (B x (S'.wittFst x') - y) - B x
      (S'.wittFst (n • x' - x')) - y)).2.2 (by
    convert (H ⟨_, g, rfl⟩).2.symm.elim (sub_mem <| ·.elim sub_mem) using 1
    linear_combination (norm := (simp +zetaDelta [*, (phi_mul_comm _).eq]; abel)) hd - n • hd)

steps.claim: φD_g − D_g ∈ S_m: it is a combination of the second, third and fourth safety conditions of H at g (with hd and its translate by n), φ commuting with n.
steps.lean:
(by
    convert (H ⟨_, g, rfl⟩).2.symm.elim (sub_mem <| ·.elim sub_mem) using 1
    linear_combination (norm := (simp +zetaDelta [*, (phi_mul_comm _).eq]; abel)) hd - n • hd)

steps.claim: For g, h ∈ Γ': ζ_m(p^e·modPairing(P)(α(c)(g), g·α'(c')(h))) = ζ_m(r·(χ(g)κ(h) − κ(gh) + κ(g))), because the difference of the arguments is 1⊗(something) lying in S_m, hence 0 (h₀):
steps.lean:
have key (g h : k.Γ') := congrArg (zmodPowToUnits _) (sub_eq_zero.1 (h₀ (p ^ e • P.modPairing
    ((S.α c).1 g) (S'.ρ g ((S'.α c').1 h)) - r • (charRep _ χ g.1 (κ h) - κ (g * h) + κ g)) (by
    convert nsmul_mem (add_mem ((H ⟨_, g, rfl⟩).1 ⟨_, h, rfl⟩) (add_mem (sub_mem
      (smul_mem_smallPart g.1 (hκ h)) (hκ (g * h))) (hκ g))) r
    simp +zetaDelta [*, -h₀, pow_add, mul_comm]; abel)))

steps.claim: it is r times the sum of the first safety condition of H at (g, h) and of the defects hκ(h) moved by g (S_m is Galois stable), hκ(gh) and hκ(g), expanded with the cocycle identities and p^e = p^{e₁+e₂+e₃}r.
steps.lean:
(by
    convert nsmul_mem (add_mem ((H ⟨_, g, rfl⟩).1 ⟨_, h, rfl⟩) (add_mem (sub_mem
      (smul_mem_smallPart g.1 (hκ h)) (hκ (g * h))) (hκ g))) r
    simp +zetaDelta [*, -h₀, pow_add, mul_comm]; abel)))

steps.claim: The cup-product class x vanishes because it has two coprime annihilators: [Γ : Γ'] is prime to p (index_coprime), so [Γ : Γ']·x = 0 and p^m·x = 0 give x = 0 (nsmul_eq_zero_iff_of_coprime); two separate steps: the first by restriction and corestriction (9.1–9.3), the second because the values are p^m-th roots of unity (9.4):
steps.lean:
refine mem_comap.1 <| (ker_mkQ _).le <| (nsmul_eq_zero_iff_of_coprime (index_coprime.pow_right
    _)).1 ⟨((unitsModule _).restrictAlong ⟨toGp, hj.continuous⟩).index_smul_eq_zero_of_resH2 ⟨_,
    k.Γ'.isOpen_of_mem_nhds (u (·.2))⟩ (x := ⟦⟨_, ((iff_eventually_eq _).2 fun q ↦
    map_mul_left_nhds_one q ▸ ((N.and (V (coboundary_mem ((S'.α c').1 q.2)))
    ).prod_nhds N).mono (by rintro ⟨⟩ ⟨⟨⟨-, ⟨⟨⟩⟩⟩, _, e⟩, ⟨⟨⟩⟩⟩; simp [*, -h₀, eq_add_of_sub_eq e,
    ↓nsmul_quot_eq_zero])).continuous, by simp [map_cyclotomicGp_smul _ nsmul_zmodPowToUnits, Z, X,
    modPairing_rho, Units.smul_def]⟩⟧) ((ker_mkQ _).ge ⟨zmodPowToUnits _ ∘ (r • κ),
    (isLocallyConstant_of_eventually_mul (.mono (continuousAt_subtype_val N) ?_)).continuous,
    by simpa [map_cyclotomicGp_smul _ nsmul_zmodPowToUnits, charRep] using!
    key⟩), congr(⟦⟨fun _ ↦ $(nsmul_zmodPowToUnits _), _⟩⟧)⟩

steps.claim: [Γ:Γ']·x = 0 when the restriction of x to the open subgroup Γ' vanishes (index_smul_eq_zero_of_resH2; Γ' is open as it contains a neighbourhood of 1, u).
x is the class of the 2-cocycle (g, h) ↦ ζ_m(p^e·modPairing(P)(α(c)(g), g·α'(c')(h))), continuous because locally constant: near any (g, h) its value does not change, by step 5 and step 2.
steps.lean:
(x := ⟦⟨_, ((iff_eventually_eq _).2 fun q ↦
    map_mul_left_nhds_one q ▸ ((N.and (V (coboundary_mem ((S'.α c').1 q.2)))
    ).prod_nhds N).mono (by rintro ⟨⟩ ⟨⟨⟨-, ⟨⟨⟩⟩⟩, _, e⟩, ⟨⟨⟩⟩⟩; simp [*, -h₀, eq_add_of_sub_eq e,
    ↓nsmul_quot_eq_zero])).continuous, by simp [map_cyclotomicGp_smul _ nsmul_zmodPowToUnits, Z, X,
    modPairing_rho, Units.smul_def]⟩⟧)

steps.claim: its restriction to Γ' is the coboundary of the cochain ζ_m∘(r·κ) (step 8), continuous because κ is locally constant near 1 (proved in step 10).
steps.lean:
((ker_mkQ _).ge ⟨zmodPowToUnits _ ∘ (r • κ),
    (isLocallyConstant_of_eventually_mul (.mono (continuousAt_subtype_val N) ?_)).continuous,
    by simpa [map_cyclotomicGp_smul _ nsmul_zmodPowToUnits, charRep] using!
    key⟩),

steps.claim: The second annihilator: p^m·x = 0, because p^m·ζ_m(y) = 0 for every y (ζ_m takes values in the p^m-th roots of unity, written additively: nsmul_zmodPowToUnits), so p^m times the cocycle is 0.
κ is locally constant near 1: for h near 1 (with the properties of step 5), κ(gh) and κ(g) differ by an element of ℤ/p^m(1) ∩ S_m, hence agree (h₀, step 8).
steps.lean:
rintro h ⟨⟨⟩, ⟨⟩, e₁, e₀⟩ _
  simpa [*, -h₀, ↓nsmul_quot_eq_zero, eq_neg_add_iff_add_eq, h₀ _ (by
    convert sub_mem (sub_mem e₀ e₁) (hκ h); simp +zetaDelta [*, -smul_smul]; abel)] using key _ h
